reference.method: GLS profile in M and -5log10(H0/70); golden-section Omega_m search

covariance_validation.treatment: (C + C.T) / 2 before Cholesky; all correlations retained

record_validation.scope: Every row checked for shape, finiteness and bounds; every generation checked for optimum; 12 spread candidates and final optimum independently rescored per run.
